title: Renewal Calendar Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(vendor_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many renewal calendar event events land each day and how many distinct vendor name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest renewal calendar event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct vendor name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much renewal calendar event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
